title: feat(plugin-approvals): approval steps reach the record activity stream as approval feed items
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBEaJzgBWzjWCNjBjkVoeRto)_

Fixes #35723

repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzg3KqwSpt61Y8ovKK7

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:在走审批的记录详情页「动态」里,每个审批步骤(提交、通过、驳回、退回修改、重新提交、撤回、取消)都显示为一行,按读者的语言显示(中文读者看到「已批准 · 经理审批」),点「看审批」直接打开该记录的「审批」页签;以前这里看不到任何审批。
- 为什么做:记录详情页专题里「动态流审批一行」那一半——上一张卡只画了这一行的样子,但没有任何地方产出审批条目,这张卡补上产出方。
- 出错会怎样:最坏情况是动态里少了或多了审批行,或某行显示成英文;审批本身、审批页签和锁定都不受影响。撤回本 PR 后,已写入的审批行仍在动态表里保留最多 14 天,且失去本 PR 的可见性限制,会以普通系统行的样子展示给所有能看该记录的人。
- 要你做什么:无

## What changes

- **Producer (plugin-approvals, new module `approval-activity-feed.ts`).** An `afterInsert` hook on the decision log `sys_approval_action` appends one `sys_activity` row per step of kind `submit`, `approve`, `reject`, `revise` (sent back for revision), `resubmit`, `recall` and `cancel`, about the record the request governs. Other kinds (reminder, reassign, thread comment, ...) write none, and no decision comment rides on the row. An object with `enable.activities: false` gets no entry, as the CRUD mirror writes none for it. Shape follows ADR-0052 section 5, so no published vocabulary moves: `type: 'system'` (platform-only; the app activity door refuses it), `metadata.kind: 'approval'` plus the step's action, its stored label and the two machine names its label is translated by (`flow_name`, `step_name`), `source_object: 'sys_approval_request'` / `source_id` naming the request.
- **In the reader's language (route b, round 2).** `summary` stores the English sentence from plugin-approvals' own catalog (`approvalActivity*` in `translations/messages.ts`, ten ids added to all eleven shipped packs); a new `sys_activity` middleware (`bindApprovalActivityLocale`) re-composes it on `find` / `findOne` for a non-system read that carries a locale, with the approvals door's own lookup (`readerLabelsFor`): the sentence is `messages.approvalActivity*` in the reader's locale, and the step label is `flows.FLOW.approvals.NODE.label` read the way the approvals tab reads it, else the stored label. A list that projects `summary` alone borrows the recognition columns and hands back only what it asked for. A system read, a read with no locale or no `i18n` service, or a key the pack misses serves the stored line. No `sys_activity` on the deployment (no plugin-audit) means no write; a failed append never fails the step and is logged once at `error` with consequence and fix. `approval-service.ts` is untouched (overlap with PR #37145 and branch `claude/project-thread-x90m5y` avoided).
- **Read gate (same module).** A `sys_activity` middleware narrows `find` / `findOne` / `count` / `aggregate` so an approval row is served only when the approvals service would serve the caller its request (`RequestVisibilitySource`, the same source the request-table gates read). A read pinning `object_name` + `record_id` asks with that record, so an object that opts into `enable.approvalsVisibleToReaders` serves its readers too. Every non-approval row passes untouched; plugin-audit's parent-record gate still applies on top; failure to resolve fails closed for approval rows only. Count and rows agree.
- **Console (plugin-detail).** `activityRowToFeedItem` reads the triple `type: 'system'` + `metadata.kind: 'approval'` + `source_object: 'sys_approval_request'` as the `approval` feed kind (`APPROVAL_ACTIVITY_FEED_TYPE`), so `PRODUCED_FEED_TYPES` now contains `approval` and the unproduced-kind diagnostic no longer names it. New `RecordViewApprovalsContext` carries the stream's 「看审批」 callback into `RecordActivityRenderer` and `RecordChatterPanel`.
- **Host (app-shell `RecordDetailView`).** The approval tag's opener is extracted as `openRecordApprovals` (approvals panel if drawn, else the 审批 tab) and supplied through `RecordViewApprovalsContext` only when the reader is served approvals; otherwise the line has no link.
- **Docs.** `content/docs/frontend/plugins/plugin-detail.mdx`: `approval` joins the produced-kinds table (six produced, seven not); the unproduced example becomes `call`.
- **Ledgers.** `approver-address-readers.test.ts` classifies the two new `actor_id` reads as `display`; the tenant-audit write census for plugin-approvals is regenerated (one new elevated `sys_activity` insert); `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx` row 17 owns the new middleware's `isSystem` read (its register regenerated with `--write`).

## Round 2 (L1 REWORK on dc76347753)

- **S1, route (b): the server re-composes on read.** It is the #26167 precedent's own shape: plugin-audit's `activity-summary-message.ts` stores the sentence plus its code and re-composes it per reader in a `sys_activity` middleware, and this row's code is already on it (`metadata.action`, now with `flow_name` / `step_name`). The step label must be translated through the app's flows pack, which lives in the server's `i18n` service and is read by the approvals door's `reader-locale-labels` lookup; the console holds no such pack. Server-side, every reader of the column (the record page, the API, an export) gets the same line, and no console locale pack moves. Pinned for a zh-CN reader: `已批准 · 经理审批` and `已提交审批`, with the step label from an app flows pack.
- **S2:** handled by the zone (claim amended).
- **N1:** done in the same code path: `revise`, `resubmit` and `cancel` write entries (`Sent back for revision · STEP`, `Resubmitted for approval`, `Approval request cancelled`, the last attributed to no one), each pinned.
- **N2:** the flag is honored, as the CRUD mirror honors it (`audit-writers.ts` writes no activity row for an object with `enable.activities: false`); pinned.
- **N3:** the step half is pinned exactly (`Approved · Manager review`, `Rejected · Manager review`), plus the stored metadata.
- **N4:** the 维护者速读 revert sentence now says rows already written stay up to 14 days and, without the read gate, are served to every record reader as generic system lines.

## Tests

<details><summary>Readings, round 2 (head 06a3c7640b)</summary>

All local runs went through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`; verdict lines quoted. Round-2 head `06a3c7640b` (after merging `origin/main` at `93bd45957b`).

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-approvals exec vitest run` + `typecheck` (head `06a3c764` minus the cancel pin): `Test Files 129 passed (129)`, `Tests 1929 passed (1929)`, `check:test-typecheck: OK`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `src/approval-activity-feed-35723.integration.test.ts` at `06a3c7640b`: `Tests 7 passed (7)` (approve/reject/recall, send back + resubmit, cancel on record delete, muted timeline, zh-CN reader, reader without approval access, record-reader opt-in).
- Ablation (S1): `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced the `bindApprovalActivityLocale(...)` call in `approvals-plugin.ts` with a no-op (anchor 1 to 0, blob changed); the zh-CN pin went red (`Tests 1 failed | 6 passed (7)`, the six others green), restore verified (`blob == HEAD`, `git diff HEAD` empty).
- Local gate subset: `dispatch-gates --ran` reconciles `106 derived, 104 run, 2 UNRUN`; 101 exit 0. `check:i18n` first exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET), then its own one-command prerequisite build and re-run: `check-i18n-bundles: OK (10 package(s) — all bundles in sync, no undeclared authoring keys)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`. `check:system-context-census` (red in CI on `05d82f29`) fixed in `f0b51c92`: `OK — 202 elevation read sites ... the generated register (178 symbol(s)) matches the tree`, self-test all cases passed. NOT MEASURED locally, CI runs them: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `spec check:skill-examples` (exit 3, unbuilt dist outside the closure); `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` and `check:type-check-debt` (declared narrowing: the first was OOM-killed in round 1, the second needs a whole-workspace build; no `ui/` file and no package's type-check set changed this round).
- `overlap-check --branch=claude/issue-35723-approval-feed-items`: `VERDICT clean exit 0`.
- Round 1 readings (UI suites, record-page ablation) stand for the unchanged `ui/` files: `RecordDetailView.*` 100 files / 858 tests, plugin-detail 417 files, both `type-check` exit 0.
- Full dogfood: not owed (no `!` in the title, no `(narrowing)` arm).

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `sys_activity` keeps its own lifecycle (rows reaped after 14 days); the 审批 tab keeps the full history. Steps taken before this lands write no backfilled rows.
- The console restates the three writer values (`recordActivityFeed.ts`) because plugin-detail cannot depend on the server plugin; both sides are pinned by tests.
- The producer reads the decision log rather than calling in from each decision method, so a step the service learns to record elsewhere reaches the stream with no second call site.
- New UI pin for the mapper and stream lives in a card-named file `recordActivityFeed.approvalStep-35723.test.tsx` (it renders React; the shared `recordActivityFeed.test.ts` is a non-JSX file). The record-page pin joined the shared `RecordDetailView.harness.test.tsx` as its own top-level block.

## Verification

First read (by risk):
1. `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approval-activity-feed.ts` — `bindApprovalActivityReadGate` (who sees an approval row), `bindApprovalActivityLocale` (the system-read pass-through and the borrowed columns), and the producer hook's transaction and tenant context.
2. `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/recordActivityFeed.ts` — `isApprovalStepRow`, the mapping branch.
3. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx` — `openRecordApprovals` / `viewApprovals`, a plain function below the page's early returns (a hook there breaks hook order).

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-approvals exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/approval-activity-feed-35723.integration.test.ts` — expect 7 passed: one entry per step (approve / reject / recall, send back and resubmit, cancel on record delete), none on a muted timeline, a zh-CN reader served `已批准 · 经理审批`, none served to a reader without approval access while other entries stay, and served under the record-reader opt-in.
